column3: MT 54:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְעָרִיצִים (“the ruthless”) is rendered “oppressors.”
Close to the Hebrew; “among those who sustain” is rendered “with those who uphold.”
NKJV follows the traditional reading, “He will repay,” where the written text has the wish “may the evil return.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with a freewill offering” is rendered “freely.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my eye has looked on” is rendered “my eye has seen its desire upon.”
